label: TP-Link EAP230-Wall
description: AC1200 wall-plate access point: one gigabit uplink (PoE in) and one gigabit downlink, dual-band Wi-Fi 5.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: uplink 1x 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port and downlink 1x 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port; 5 GHz up to 867 Mbps and 2.4 GHz up to 300 Mbps (IEEE 802.11n/g/b/ac); powered by 802.3af or 802.3at PoE. Gigabit on both ports, unlike the older EAP225-Wall whose uplink is fast Ethernet.
